hasClose.description: Whether to display a close button on each tab. When enabled, users can remove tabs individually. Default: false.

hug.description: Enables "hug" mode for a more compact tab layout with reduced padding. Default: false.

showSubtitle.description: Whether to display subtitle text for each tab. Individual tabs can override this with tab.showSubtitle. Default: false.

hasAddNewTab.description: Whether to display an "add new tab" button at the end of the tab row. When clicked, emits the add-new-tab event. Default: false.

tabs.description: The tabs, one object each: `id` (unique; the events report it), `title`, `subtitle`, `showSubtitle`, `hasLeadingIcon`, `iconName` (an OpenBridge icon the module bundles, in the tab's leading icon slot; the element draws a placeholder icon where a tab has none, so a tab without an icon states `hasLeadingIcon` false), `hasBadge`, `badgeCount`, `badgeType`, `badgeSize`, `badgeShowNumber`, `showLeadingBadgeIcon` and `disabled`. The element's `badges` list is not carried.

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
